scope: Preliminary complete construction of a reinforced-concrete dry potable-water booster pumping station. The ordinary route accepts only station count and identity, hydraulic duty, pump arrangement, internal structural dimensions and measured incoming power-cable route. Civil geometry, concrete, reinforcement, formwork, waterproofing, backfill, mechanical assembly, electrical-controls, testing, labor, mechanisms, procurement balance and logistics are calculated from those primary facts and the visible editable engineering profile.
calculationPrinciples: outer dimensions and excavation are derived from internal dimensions, wall and slab thicknesses and working clearance
structural concrete is the sum of base slab, four walls and roof slab, with procurement loss separated
reinforcement, formwork, blinding, waterproofing and backfill follow the calculated structural geometry
pump accessories are derived from the selected pump arrangement and visible per-pump or per-station assembly coefficients
labor and equipment are derived from calculated physical quantities and visible productivity factors
power-cable order is recalculated from installed route, loss, retained spare, available stock and supplier drum length
conditional shoring, groundwater lowering and standby generation remain fail-closed
exclusions: external distribution network, reservoir, water intake and treatment plant
claim that the preliminary profile is an approved universal norm
